nodes.characterization_summary: SERS identifies S-H intermediate at -250 mV RHE without Mo-H signals, confirming S atoms of MoS2 as HER active sites in Ag@MoS2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Direct spectroscopic evidence emerged from the Raman spectra identifies the formation of an S-H intermediate upon reaching a potential of -250 mV versus reversible hydrogen electrode (mV RHE)), without any detectable Mo-H vibrational signals, directly supporting that the S atom of MoS2 is the real HER active site.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman detects S-H stretching vibration without Pt-H signals, confirming S atoms as HER active sites in PtS2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A vibration band corresponding to the stretching vibration of S-H bond was observed without detecting Pt-H vibrations, indicating that S atoms serve as the real active sites.

nodes.characterization_summary: XAS reveals decreased Co-Se coordination number and increased Co/Se valence states in S-doped Co0.85Se due to strong Co-S bonding.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XAS results illustrated that S introduction leads to a decrease in the coordination number of Co-Se bond and an increase in the valence states of both Co and Se, forming a strong Co-S bond due to stronger electronegativity of S.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman spectroscopy detects S-H* intermediate formation at -0.1 V and -0.15 V RHE on S-NiFe2O4 during alkaline HER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ Raman spectroscopy identified the formation of S-H* intermediate on the S-NiFe2O4 during the alkaline HER process at potentials of -0.1 V and -0.15 V RHE, indicating that S atoms are active sites.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman confirms strong H adsorption on Ru and moderate adsorption on Si sites in LaRuSi catalyst under HER conditions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ Raman spectra of LaRuSi catalyst at various potentials under HER conditions in 1 M KOH.

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution O 1s XPS shows significant increase in oxygen vacancy concentration on AgRuO3 after alkaline HER reaction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution deconvoluted XPS spectra of O 1s.
